title: Paz Vizsla
description: An impressive warrior encased in the strongest of beskar armor suits, Paz Vizsla is descended from a long line of Mandalorian leaders. As part of the Mandalorian covert led by the Armorer, Paz Vizsla fought on Nevarro against the Empire. He joined in the fight to rescue Nevarro from pirates after Bo-Katan and Din Djarin helped him rescue his son. He gave his life protecting those in the covert from the Praetorians in Moff Gideon's control as they sought to take back Mandalore for their people.
